info.title: Unsora API
info.description: Public API for Unsora integrations. Authenticate with Clerk JWT or uns_live_* API key. API keys are rate-limited to 60 requests/minute and support idempotency keys. Async jobs complete via polling GET /public/image/status/{id}.

bearerAuth.description: Clerk session JWT or Unsora API key (uns_live_*)

caption.description: Post caption shown on connected platforms

media.description: video, slideshow, or null for text-only drafts. Legacy: array of {type, url} items.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 with timezone. At least 2 minutes ahead. Omit for draft.

timezone.description: IANA timezone label stored with the post

external_id.description: Idempotency key (alias for Idempotency-Key header on API key requests)

settings.description: Optional Instagram and TikTok publish options only. Same fields may be sent at the top level as `instagram` or `tiktok`.

cover_url.description: Optional Instagram Reel cover image URL

PostSettings.description: Optional publish options for Instagram and TikTok only. All fields are optional.

cover_url.description: Custom Reel cover image URL (JPG/PNG). Alias: coverUrl.

PostSettingsTiktok.description: TikTok-only options. Applied to each TikTok account on the post. Query creator_info for allowed privacy_level values.

post_mode.description: DIRECT_POST publishes immediately; MEDIA_UPLOAD sends to the TikTok inbox for the user to finish in-app.

privacy_level.description: Must match a value from TikTok creator_info (e.g. PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE, SELF_ONLY).

music_usage_confirmation.description: Confirm third-party music usage rights when required by TikTok.

brand_content_toggle.description: Paid partnership promoting a third-party brand.

auto_add_music.description: Photo posts only — let TikTok add background music.

photo_cover_index.description: Slideshow only — zero-based index of the cover image.

video_cover_timestamp_ms.description: Video reel only — frame timestamp for the cover thumbnail.

model.description: Model key: nano-banana-2, nano-banana-pro, seedream-v5-lite, gpt-image-1.5, gpt-image-2

ratio.description: Aspect ratio; allowed values depend on model

resolution.description: Output size or quality; allowed values depend on model

lyrics.description: Song lyrics (required for song models, up to 3000 chars)

prompt.description: Style prompt — genre, mood, vocal style (up to 1024 chars)

model.description: Model key: auto, mureka-9, mureka-8, mureka-o2, mureka-7.6, mureka-7.5

CreateVideoRequest.description: Seedance 2.0 only (seedance_2.0, 1080p). Model is not selectable on the public API.

generate_audio.description: Generate a soundtrack/audio for the video.

scheduledFor.description: Set null to clear schedule and revert to draft

ClippingConfig.description: Job settings echoed back in resolved form: targetDuration as DURATION_*, ratio as RATIO_* (null when keeping the original ratio), captionStyle as the underlying template ID.

query.description: Find Moments query the job was created with; null for regular viral-clip jobs.

order.description: Clip index, ranked by virality (0 = highest).

startTime.description: Start offset in the source video, seconds.

endTime.description: End offset in the source video, seconds.

outputAsset.description: Rendered clip video. Contains the downloadable url once the job completes.

metadata.description: Extra AI output: tags, desc (suggested description), score (virality).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. Replays the original response for 24h when using an API key.

videoUrl.description: Public URL of the source video (YouTube link or direct video URL).

sourceLang.description: Source language code of the video (e.g. en, es). Omit or null to auto-detect.

targetLang.description: Target language for clip titles, descriptions, and captions. Omit or null to keep the source language.

targetDuration.description: Desired length range for each clip. Defaults to auto (up to 90s).

query.description: Find Moments mode: natural-language description of the moments to extract (e.g. "funny reactions", "product demos", "goal moments and key plays"). When set, targetDuration is ignored. Omit to auto-detect the most viral clips.

limit.description: Maximum number of clips to return, ranked by virality score (highest first). Omit to return all viral-worthy clips.

ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. AI reframe keeps the main subject centered when cropping. Use 9:16 for TikTok/Reels/Shorts, 1:1 or 4:5 for feed posts, 16:9 for YouTube. Omit or use original to keep the source ratio.

enableCaption.description: Burn animated captions into the exported clips.

captionStyle.description: Caption style preset, named by look — the color is the accent on the spoken word. glow-* styles add a soft glow, static-* styles don't animate, gaming-* are bold streamer styles, white-card/black-box place text on a card. Only used when enableCaption is true. Defaults to classic-yellow.

201.description: Job queued. Clips render asynchronously — poll GET /public/clippings/status/{clippingId} until status is COMPLETED.

400.description: Invalid input (bad videoUrl, targetDuration, limit, ratio, or captionStyle), or video length could not be determined.

402.description: Insufficient credits. Cost is charged per started minute of the source video.

post.description: Submit a video for AI clipping. By default the AI auto-detects the most viral clips. Set query to switch to Find Moments mode: describe the moments you want in natural language (e.g. "funny reactions") and the AI extracts matching clips instead — targetDuration is ignored in that mode. Cost is charged per started minute of the source video either way.

get.description: Paginated list of basic image generations for the authenticated user.
Full image generation record including assets.
Syncs with the clipping provider while the job is in progress, then returns the job with clips.
Read-only view from the database without provider sync.
